entries.title: Psalms 65:1
segments: Title, A Psalm and Song; or, "A Psalm, a Song;" that is, a psalm which is also a song of praise.  This psalm is properly named a song, for it celebrates God's majesty, greatness, and forgiving love; especially his goodness, as manifested in the gift of "rain from heaven and fruitful seasons."

entries.title: Psalms 65:2
segments: Shall all flesh come; all flesh is dependent on God for life and breath and all things; and shall come to God in prayer, in the day when all nations shall be enlightened by his word and Spirit.

entries.title: Psalms 65:3
segments: Purge them away; forgive their sins and purify their souls through the great atonement.

entries.title: Psalms 65:4
segments: No blessedness is so great as that which results from being chosen of God to salvation, through the sanctification of the Spirit, and belief of his truth.

entries.title: Psalms 65:5
segments: Terrible things; those which God accomplishes for the destruction of his enemies and the salvation of his people.

entries.title: Psalms 65:7
segments: God rules in the kingdoms of nature and of providence, as well as of grace, and controls all things according to the wise and good counsels of his own perfect will.

entries.title: Psalms 65:8
segments: Thy tokens; the signs of God's presence and almighty power in nature.

entries.title: Psalms 65:9
segments:
The river of God; God's inexhaustible store of waters, from which he sends upon the earth refreshing showers. 
 
All the blessings of this life come from God, and are the fruit of his kindness, mercy, and grace to the children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 65:11
segments: Thy paths drop fatness; that is, wherever thou goest thou scatterest fatness around thee.  Fatness stands here, as often elsewhere, for a rich abundance of the best gifts.

entries.title: Psalms 65:12
segments: They drop; drop fatness.  But we may render more literally, "the pastures of the wilderness drop," that is, with fatness, in consequence of God's visit to them.

entries.title: Psalms 65:13
segments: All the works of God praise him, and his saints bless him for the mercies of this life and of that which is to come.
